subject: Expanding to additional squads — credentialing & timeline
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@astrabyte.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15 09:12 PST
Subject: Expanding to additional squads — credentialing & timeline

Hi Elena,

Great to speak earlier — excited AstraByte is ready to push Redwood across two more product squads (Search and Composer). To keep the launch low-friction, I sketched a short rollout plan and credentialing approach. High level:

- Add 4 new projects (one per team) and issue separate API keys per project for least-privilege access.
- Stagger provisioning across two sprints (Search squad week of Nov 29; Composer week of Dec 13).
- Provide onboarding docs + short session with your infra engineers.

I'm attaching a quick MAP (migration and access plan) and our key provisioning instructions. Can you confirm:
1) Who from your infra will own key rotation? (Jordan? procurement will handle PO).
2) Do you need an updated quote with the additional SKUs and a 12-month term?

If that timeline works I can loop in Rishi to finalize pricing and Sergio for the rollout runbook.

Best,
Monica
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Monica Patel | monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: AstraByte_Migration_MAP.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood_API_Key_Instructions.pdf (pdf)

Monica,

Thanks — that looks good at a glance. Quick answers:
- Jordan (cc'd) will own day-to-day key ops and rotation.
- Procurement will need an updated quote and an estimate of token/unit usage per squad to include in the PO.

Two asks from our side before we lock dates:
1) A short diagram of the least-privilege key mapping per environment (dev/stage/prod).
2) Confirmation of any changes to SLAs if we add the additional capacity (esp for Dedicated calls).

Jordan — can you confirm availability for the onboarding call Nov 30?

—Elena
Head of Platform | AstraByte

Hi Elena / team,

Thanks for the quick responses. Per Monica's outline, I've prepared a pricing delta for the incremental capacity and a 12-month amendment option. Key points:

- Increment: 4 project keys, estimated blended consumption: 2.4M tokens / month across both squads.
- Pricing: incremental unit rate is 4.5% lower than current tier if you commit to 12 months on the added capacity.
- SLA: No change to standard Dedicated SLA; we can add a 99.9% uptime rider for an additional 0.25% ARR.

Attached: Q4_Pricing_Schedule_v3.xlsx — this has the per-squad forecast and a sample amendment language for the commitment.

Next steps:
- If procurement is comfortable, Rustom (PO contact) can issue a PO referencing deal AB-2026-Q4-0192.
- Sergio and Lauren will run the onboarding checklist and schedule the infra call.

Monica — can you confirm whether the two-sprint cadence below covers your delivery commitments?

- Sprint A (Nov 29–Dec 3): Provision Search squad projects, verify dev/stage keys, onboarding call Nov 30.
- Sprint B (Dec 13–Dec 17): Provision Composer squad projects, run smoke tests, finalize runbook.

Thanks,
Rishi
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q4_Pricing_Schedule_v3.xlsx

Subject: Runbook & credentialing playbook for AstraByte expansion

Hi all,

Attaching the short runbook and the key provisioning checklist. Highlights:

1) Credential mapping: each squad gets a project-level API key with environment tags (dev/stage/prod). Keys are scoped to project and model access.
2) Rotation: we expose an API for auto-rotation (POST /v1/projects/{project_id}/keys/{key_id}/rotate). We'll provide a temporary token for Jordan to test.
3) Smoke tests: included 8 minimal cases for Composer latency validation and 6 for Search throughput sanity checks.

Proposed schedule (matching Rishi):
- Nov 30 (11:00 PST): 30-min onboarding + rotation demo (Jordan + infra).
- Dec 1–3: Provision dev/stage for Search, run tests.
- Dec 13–17: Provision Composer and finalize runbook.

We'll hand over the temporary rotation token during the call and retire it after validation.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_API_Key_Instructions.pdf
